storage: Keep on the counter for a few days or in the fridge crisper for up to a few weeks. Squeezed juice keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge in a closed jar.
looksLike: A small round-to-oval citrus fruit with thin skin that is green to bright yellow. Indian shops sell it by weight (200–250 g packs) or in packs of 4 to 6 pieces; imported larger lemons and Thai lemon are sold separately at higher prices.
howToPick: Heavy for its size with thin, smooth, slightly shiny skin; a gentle squeeze should give a little. Avoid hard, dull, shrivelled or mouldy ones.
shelfLife: About 1 week on the counter and 3 to 4 weeks in the fridge (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Tamarind water or a pinch of citric acid

usedIn.raw: 5 ml juice per serving (1 tsp, about ¼ lemon)
